note: Verbatim from Google, typos included. Each review names the listing it appears on. With source "manual", dates are approximate, worked back from the relative dates Google shows; the Google API replaces them with exact ones. Show ratings, never review counts.

reviews.name: Jim Degnan
reviews.text: Duncan's choices for hotels were outstanding, greatly exceeding out expections

reviews.name: Alfred Adarkwah
reviews.text: Duncan and his team are absolutely amazing. Within 12 hours (while he was traveling), my travel accommodations were made plus got an upgrade. He’s someone I’ll work with forever!

reviews.name: Bob LaBass
reviews.text:
Duncan, thanks for everything.
1. Normandy.....Utah and Omaha beaches, the cemetery....made me cry and I don't cry
2. Sacred Heart in Paris....stayed for a mass, the music was amazing despite the crowds.
3. Going to my church Sunday services in Paris, I belong to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (Mormon)
The was peaceful, i completely lost track of time and day and fell out of my routines, it was perfect.
thanks again for everything
b

reviews.name: Holly Sorkin
reviews.text: Duncan's hotel advice was spot on in response to our preferences. Tours were also very well planned. It was a pleasure to have guides show us places of the beaten path! Without this expertise, our Scotland visit would have been less leisurely and less fun.

reviews.name: michael waldron
reviews.text: Duncan and his team made our honeymoon an unforgettable experience! From helping us brainstorm destinations to making adjustments when we had to pivot and change flights and parts of our itinerary, they were there every step of the way. They were incredibly responsive, thoughtful, and helpful throughout the entire planning process and even while we were traveling. Every detail was customized to us, and everything was seamless from start to finish. I highly recommend using Duncan and his team!

reviews.name: Devon Ventura
reviews.text: My husband and I used GTM for our delayed honeymoon/first anniversary trip celebration! We worked closely with Taylor Wiles, and she was exceptionally good at thinking of everything I had not!! 1000/10 recommend! Had it not have been for their crew, we wouldn’t have ever even know about the island of Ischia, but we are so incredibly happy they introduced us to it!!

reviews.name: D H
reviews.text: Great recommendation for the Hilton Waikaloa the kids love this resort! Overall had a great time in Hawaii. Thanks Linda for researching our trip to Hawaii!

reviews.name: Greg W
reviews.text: Our advisor, Taylor Wiles, made our Orient Express and cruise spectacular. She arranged seamless transportation from the airport to the port, from the port to our hotels, and back to the airport. She helped us pick spectacular hotels that were five-star quality without the five-star price. We will definitely use Global Travel Moments for our next trip.

reviews.name: Richard Kitching
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of dealing with Duncan, not only was the service amazing but he really tailored our experience to our needs. Even when the our flights were moved by the airline, Duncan was quick to assist and ensured we still had ana amazing honeymoon. Couldn't of been happier!!

reviews.name: Daniel Mosebach
reviews.text: Duncan made the process of planning a trip for 10 adults across multiple cities a breeze. I appreciated his recommendations and insights! It was a fantastic trip.

reviews.name: Jon Henwood
reviews.text: Amazing travel ideas and great to know that everything is taken care of, so you can just relax and not have to worry about planning and logistics.

reviews.name: Mark Brant
reviews.text: Duncan & Team have organised fantastic trips for my family.  From multi city fun across Japan to relaxing Seychelles breaks and even simple European city breaks.  They take care of every detail and check in regularly.  They have first hand experience of the destinations and take time to understand the travelling party and their needs.  Highly recommended :)

reviews.name: keith wells
reviews.text: Duncan from global Travel is exceptional. He can’t help enough and is VERY patient with you when you want to change details of trips etc.

reviews.name: matthew drinkwater
reviews.text:
Working with Duncan Greenfield-Turk takes all the effort out of travel in the best possible way, we have had this joy for a number of years and even more trips.

He just gets it. From understanding how you like to travel to making sure every detail is handled properly, everything feels smooth, considered and completely tailored. The right rooms, the right recommendations, and those small touches you wouldn’t think to ask for but make all the difference.

And when things need adjusting, he’s calm, responsive and sorts it quickly without any fuss.

It’s not overcomplicated or overdone, just really good, reliable service that makes your trips better.

reviews.name: Matthew Murgatroyd
reviews.text:
Above and beyond may be an understatement. Rarely do you encounter a company with such professionalism and thorough, thoughtful service.

I was trying to plan a trip to the Victoria Falls to propose to my partner. Naturally, I was quite nervous and wanted to secure a little extra luxury. Butter her up a bit, to secure that all important "YES"!!

Duncan and the team from GTM not only made the sure that the experience was once-in-a-lifetime special, they also catered to our every need. From flights to food to accommodation to activities. They really did handle it all allowing us to relax and enjoy our holiday stress free.

P.S. We got engaged!

reviews.name: Matt Bailey
reviews.text: Used GTM to book 2 hotels for honeymoon in Singapore and Sydney.  Had extensive conversations with Duncan about our needs, alternatives and best solutions.  Settled on the Ritz-Carlton Millenia and Shangri La Sydney.  Duncan was always on hand to chase up better deals, haggle prcies down when hotel lowered them, and coupled with Virtuoso (etc) benefits, is very difficult to beat.  Very happy to recommend.
